jobs.title: Seasonal Operations Associate (Part-Time) - Rice Village
jobs.description_text: OBJECTIVE The Seasonal Operations Associate supports store goals during peak and high-volume business periods by delivering exceptional guest experiences and bringing the ALO Brand Mission to life. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Execute inventory management processes effectively with a focus om maximizing inventory accuracy & reducing shrink Investigate and root cause inventory accuracy issues, partnering with the General/Store Manager to escalate process or system gaps Support execution of key operational functions including shipment, receiving and processing, reverse transfers, sales floor recovery, intra-day sales floor replenishment, floor set updates, and supply management Maintain and champion strong visual standards for the sales floor Work closely with reporting, budgets, expenses, inventory control, supplies, vendor relationships, technology, and facilities to ensure maintained and maximized Support a safe work environment and efficient operation through strong stockroom standards and processes Move dynamically on the retail floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team and guests Execute company-level operations-focused directives, projects and initiates, in partnership with the Operations & Visual Management team. jobs.description_text: OBJECTIVE The Seasonal Sales Associate supports store goals during peak and high-volume business periods by delivering exceptional guest experiences and bringing the ALO Brand Mission to life. The position is primarily focused on identifying and mitigating risk across Alo’s retail sanctuaries. The Senior Analyst will also evaluate relevant enterprise data and support risk analysis across broader company operations as business needs evolve. Operating with an AI-first mindset, the Senior Analyst uses approved artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and established Asset Protection methodologies to detect risk earlier, improve investigative efficiency, and guide strategic decisions. The role transforms complex data into actionable insights that protect company assets, safeguard employees and guests, and strengthen operational integrity. Consistent with Alo’s “Together We Win” principle, the Senior Analyst works collaboratively across functions, shares insights, builds alignment, and helps stakeholders turn data into meaningful action.
